QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Smashed Star Fragments
QuestInfo.0: #p2081000# seems very worried about the situation in Minar Forest. Discuss with him any solutions that might exist.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081000# says they must conduct a thorough investigation on the falling star. He needs Smashed Star Fragments.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought Smashed Star Fragments for #p2081000#'s research. #p2081000# wants to check how this star is different from other ones.\r\n

0.0: This is no time to sulk. It's not our first time facing a crisis. We've survived the fires of the Black Mage's goons, and we can survive this.\r\n
0.1: I need to do more research, that's the ticket. Will you help?\r\n

yes.0: I must know what the difference is between the star fragments in western Minar Forest and the ones before. Will you get me #b40#k #rSmashed Star Fragments#k? \r\n

no.0: We MUST figure out what the star really is. Know thyself and all the world's problems will be solved, or something like that.\r\n

1.0: Ah, you have the Smashed Star Fragments! They look nice and smashed.

yes.0: Very good. Thank you. I'll be in touch with Professor Moon about the other fragments. Thank you for all your work.\r\n

default.0: Bring me #b40#k of those #rSmashed Star Fragments#k so I can study how they're different from the other fragments.\r\n
